canvas.framing: each set's camera is its Short's camera, so the middle 9:16 strip is the Short's framing

stairs.set: 8 tiles of ../marble-stairs-song (DX 3.0, DY 2.4, top tile y 19.8), feeder chute and tube from the Short
stairs.exit: trough at y 0.6 (where tile 8 would be), inner half-width 3.2, into a tunnel block from x 33.5 to 40.5
stairs.drift: up to 0.5 units/s sideways on the stairs
stairs.medley: Marble Lullabies: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star; Are You Sleeping (Frere Jacques), then as a 2-voice round; Mary Had a Little Lamb; Silent Night

twin.set: 2 lanes of 16 tiles of ../marble-twin-stairs (DX 2.7, DY 1.6, lanes at z -3.6 and 3.6); marbles drop in from above
twin.tiles: back lane red to violet, front lane starting half way round the color wheel (HSV s 0.80, v 0.96)
twin.exit: wide trough at y 1.4, inner half-width 6.3, into a tunnel block from x 52 to 56.5, height 2.7
twin.medley: Marble Music Box classics: Ode to Joy; Minuet in G; Greensleeves; Row, Row, Row Your Boat, then as a 2-voice round

music.notes_per_beat: one per hit: tune onset, canon onset, bass on the bar's main beats, broken chord, second chord tone, then sparkles
music.arpeggio_range: the 15 semitones below the song's lowest tune note
music.loop: notes wrap round the loop end; reverb (2.4 s, 34% wet) and 35 Hz high-pass applied circularly by FFT

encode.video: H.264 medium, 6 Mbps (maxrate 6M, bufsize 12M), keyframe every 60 frames, no scene cuts, yuv420p
